# pip constraints for every CI job in ansible-test.yml and windows-dc.yml:
# `pip install -c .github/ci/requirements.txt <packages>`, or the `constraints`
# input of the setup-molecule action, which the Molecule jobs use.
# Each job still names its own packages; this file only fixes their versions,
# so all jobs run the same tools. The molecule-git-cgallagher driver isn't
# here: the action's pinned SHA versions it.
#
# ansible-core is a range, not a pin: CI tests the minors the sanity matrix
# covers (stable-2.18 .. stable-2.21). Without the cap, lint, the Kea render and
# Molecule would move to a new minor the day it ships, before sanity tests it.
# When a new ansible-core minor ships, raise this cap and add it to the sanity
# (and argument-specs) matrix in the same PR. Dependabot ignores ansible-core
# for this reason (.github/dependabot.yml).
ansible-core>=2.18,<2.22

# Exact pins, bumped monthly by Dependabot.
ansible-lint==26.10.1
kubernetes==37.0.1
molecule==26.10.0
pypsrp==0.9.1
pyyaml==6.0.3
yamllint==1.38.0
